items.scope: All automotive and related infrastructure vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
N-able branded products and technologies only.
MongoDB products only, not including end-of-life components or products.
EA issues only.
Vulnerabilities in the following Altium products only: Altium Designer, A365, Octopart, and Altium Enterprise Server.
All Gallagher security products only.

All Trellix Enterprise (formerly McAfee Enterprise and FireEye) products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Trellix Advanced Research Center (Trellix ACR) that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by or reported to cirosec researchers that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Eaton issues only.
Okta issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party products discovered by ZUSO ART that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Flock branded hardware and software products only.
All Airbus products (supported products and end-of-life/end-of-service products), as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Airbus that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Bombadil Systems that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in all of Insyde Software’s firmware and software products, as well as vulnerabilities discovered by Insyde Software that are not covered by another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities in linqi products only.
Caliptra Project components and vulnerabilities that are not in another CNA’s scope.
Vulnerabilities discovered by YesWeHack community hunters on products being tested on the platform with the permission of their owners, as part of Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure.
All IQSIGHT (formerly Bosch Building Technology - Video Systems) products including end-of-life products.
Vulnerabilities identified in Cribl products, and vulnerabilities discovered by, or reported to, Cribl that are not in another CNA’s scope.

Any Seagate or LaCie software or hardware, open or closed source, supported and end of life, as well as any vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Seagate that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All EnterpriseDB products and vulnerabilities identified in open source libraries used by EnterpriseDB products unless covered by another CNA’s scope.
All products and services developed and/or sold by Panasonic Group companies.
Intel branded products and technologies and Intel managed open source projects.
Qualcomm and Snapdragon issues only.

All products released by Teradyne Robotics subsidiaries, Universal Robots (UR) and Mobile Industrial Robots (MiR), including both actively supported and end-of-life/end-of-service products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party software identified by Teradyne Robotics that are outside the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities in PHP code (code in https://github.com/php/php-src) only.
Zoom and Keybase issues only.
Vulnerabilities in third-party software discovered by Pentraze Cybersecurity that are not in another CNA’s scope.
All HYPR products only.

All CyberDanube products, as well as vulnerabilities in third-party hardware/software discovered by CyberDanube or partners actively engaged in vulnerability research coordination, which are not within the scope of another CNA.
Vulnerabilities related to TCS-CERT’s customers’ environment and vulnerabilities related to research conducted by Cyber Solutions by Thales’ Intrusion and Application Security Team.
ABB issues only.
SICK AG issues and issues in EHS products (when related to the Endress+Hauser SICK (EHS) joint venture).
All Arista products only.
Siemens issues only.
PaperCut MF, PaperCut NG, PaperCut Hive, PaperCut Pocket, PaperCut Mobility Print, QRdoc, PaperCut Views, PaperCut Multiverse, https://www.papercut.com, and all other PaperCut products and services.
Acer issues only.
Zabbix products and Zabbix projects listed on https://git.zabbix.com/ only.
All products and projects in which OpenVPN is directly involved commercially and for OpenVPN community projects, including Private Tunnel.
openGauss issues only.
Third-party products it researches.

All BeyondTrust products, including PasswordSafe, Privileged Remote Access, Remote Support, Privilege Management for Windows/Mac, Privilege Management for Unix/Linux, Identity Security Insights, Active Directory (AD) Bridge, and Total PASM.
All Mattermost issues, and vulnerabilities discovered by Mattermost that are not in another CNA’s scope.
SolarWinds products only.
All Omnissa products and services, including Workspace ONE and Horizon.
ASR products only.
Microchip Technology products only.
Trend Micro supported products, including any end-of-life products.
Vulnerabilities in Commvault SaaS and software products only.
